_status: v1.1 (Tomás, round 6: coriander moved from garnish to ingredients, Hester audit v2; no number moves). v1 round 4. A Bronx riff on Oxford's muddled-wheel recipe (BRONX COCKTAIL pdf 358: an orange wheel cut in 8 and muddled, 60 gin, 15 each sweet and dry vermouth, 2 dashes Angostura, shaken). Changes: about 1/4 tsp cracked coriander seeds muddled with the wheel (Matrix pdf 80: coriander seeds a substitute for citrus) and fine-strained out; Peychaud's for the Angostura (the Sazerac's bitters, Oxford pdf 1750); vermouths re-proportioned 30 sweet / 5 dry to put the sugar back (Oxford's 15/15 reads 2.85 g, OUT). The wheel is thin (about 1/2 cm) and counted as the ~10 ml of juice it releases (unsourced estimate; 5-10 ml proven, 12.5+ acid OUT). Gin modelled at 47%; 43% is the floor (40% -> 18.1% OUT).
